scope.originals: June orders, abeyance-manifest submissions, RM26-4 inventoried files, DOE letter and FERC HTML snapshots. Supplemental tariff exhibits, stakeholder documents and the Senate hearing use the filing reader's separate all-original index.
scope.match: PDF: every physical page, markers in order, case and punctuation preserved, whitespace folded. DOCX: document XML word sequence, NFKC and layout bullets normalized; no page numbers. HTML: visible text nodes, script/style excluded.
scope.ocr: Machine OCR is an unreviewed search aid. Historical blank or incomplete source text layers remain intact. --check-ocr independently rerenders four comment filings and the GPO hearing on macOS.
scope.summaries: Current summaries: the project validator's quoted-run coverage and original bin/style contract, plus independent recomputation of every cited start page. These checks do not certify paraphrases or stances. Legacy summaries: strict quote-on-cited-page check only.
scope.localOnly: The untracked ferc-one-pager.pdf browser print and local copies of six June PDFs are not authoritative originals. The archived HTML files and seven published order PDFs are checked instead.
scope.captions: Stored cue files are re-rendered when present. For transcript-only rows, the saved text is fingerprinted, not independently verified against audio.
